payload.note: A volume-uniform theorem now gives Hess A[h,h]>=N*omega_L^2/3 and Var(t)<=3/(N*omega_L^2) for every L>=4 on all separable backgrounds psi(t,x)=a_t+b_x. An exact centered mode-orthogonal L=4 fixture makes the spatial-correlation remainder negative, so the all-background recentered width requires correlation absorption rather than a sign lemma. The annealed center moment, normalized lowest-mode marginal, interacting H^-1 bound, and continuum reconstruction remain open.
